premises: FeCoNiMnCu films are magnetically soft with ~10 Oe coercivity as-deposited
Adding 50 at.% Pt and RTA forms an L10 high-entropy intermetallic phase
The L10 phase exhibits high magnetic anisotropy
The L10 phase and anisotropy cause a 3 orders of magnitude coercivity increase
RTA alone (without Pt) can increase coercivity ~40-fold via anisotropic strain or directional chemical order
